public_rationale: He wrote 'I fear' this will happen. That is a statement of worry, not a firm forecast. It also depends on an 'AI bubble implosion' that he does not define and gives no date for. A hedged fear tied to an undefined, undated event has no plain reading that could be shown true or false. The antecedent is also unknown: OpenAI raised a record round in March 2026, which points away from a collapse, but no definition settles the question. So the claim is not scored.
limitations: Not grading this claim does not mean his concern was wrong or right.
Whether an AI bubble has 'imploded' is itself contested and undefined.
